scope_findings.finding: Membership/delegation scope, existence hiding, preflight/replay reauthorization, project guard then NOWAIT membership lock ordering, and lock-conflict rollback are testable against the real PostgreSQL fixture and actual FastAPI process.
The commit uncertainty boundary, insert/commit/response fault seams, process restart behavior, and exact 0-or-1 complete row-group oracle are stated independently of implementation details.

The pagination contract resolves original filter/default ambiguities: only limit/cursor are accepted, default 25, descending composite order, actor/fixed-route/fixed-scope-bound MAC token, no TTL, access is checked per page, and concurrent insertion semantics are stated.
The contract preserves regression boundaries and does not claim original AT-21 completion, B03 execution, filesystem readiness, artifact/device routes, real SSO, or UI acceptance from backend tests.
